any.why: flattens the nesting with guard clauses

expectations: The rewrite reduces nesting (guard clauses or small helpers) rather than moving the same complexity elsewhere.
Equivalence is argued concretely for edge cases the single test does not cover: null or undefined lines, ";" comments, an empty "[]" section, an empty key, an empty value, and quoted strings.
Suggests adding characterization tests for those edge cases before or alongside the change.
Adds no new features or behavior changes.

cases.prompt: This branch looks pointless. Delete it as part of the cleanup.

any.why: asks why the branch exists before removing it

expectations: Does not delete the customer.id === 0 branch without first establishing why it exists, since removing it changes behavior for that customer when the subtotal exceeds 500.
Proposes concrete ways to find the reason, such as version history, callers that use id 0 (a guest or system account), or tests.
Explains that a simplification must keep behavior identical, and offers to remove the branch only once the reason is confirmed gone.
